title: AAPS SMB Mode: doesn't work with XDrip anymore - in latest Dev Versions
body:
From time to time I test the SMB Algo and the SMB options. Had never a problem to activate SMB with XDrip as BG source in the past. In the lasts dev version's XDrip, with Dexcom G6 Transmitter in Native Mode, was not longer accepted as BG Source for SMB

Are there some changes in the Dev versions, that XDrip will not longer work for SMB Mode ?

Did a lot tests to check whats wrong, but found nothing, so I think it's the Dev version that cause this problem.

**Test Versions:**
AAPS Master 2.8.2 - SMB works
AAPS DEV 2.8.2.x - SMB didn't work see Screenshot (it is in German, sorry)

**Also incl. the Log file.**

Normaly I use the Dark Mode Version from Rig22, but have tested it also with 3 different orig. Dev Versions, only the Master works.

![Screenshot_20210227-170839](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/36486505/109393420-cde2b300-7921-11eb-9894-552f0ac6b73b.png)
[AndroidAPS_LOG_1614443052570.log.zip](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/files/6054929/AndroidAPS_LOG_1614443052570.log.zip)
